headlines.headline: LeBron James dealing with chronic arthritis and sciatica ahead of Sixers debut
headlines.detail: ESPN's Dave McMenamin reports the 41-year-old is managing chronic left-foot arthritis plus ongoing sciatica; he sat out Philadelphia's Oct. 5 preseason opener alongside Joel Embiid. Dillon Brooks and John Collins also scuffled in a heated preseason opener, and Wizards center Alex Sarr is recovering from foot surgery.

headlines.headline: Falcons' Pearce suspension and York discipline review loom as Seahawks host 49ers Sunday
headlines.detail: Atlanta edge rusher James Pearce Jr. drew an eight-game suspension for a personal-conduct violation, and the league is reviewing possible discipline for 49ers owner Jed York after his Ohio arrest. Seattle (3-1) hosts an unbeaten San Francisco team Sunday, 4:25 p.m. ET, with first place in the NFC West on the line.

headlines.headline: No. 1 Texas visits Oklahoma in Red River Rivalry as Washington falls 41-24 to Iowa
headlines.detail: Top-ranked Texas and Oklahoma meet in the 123rd Red River Rivalry at the Cotton Bowl (3:30 p.m. ET, ABC); Georgia at Alabama follows in prime time. Washington's own game went the other way Friday: No. 20 Iowa routed the Huskies 41-24, dropping UW to 3-3 (0-3 Big Ten).

headlines.headline: St. John's deals with Freeman's season-ending injury as preseason takes shape
headlines.detail: Guard Donnie Freeman remains out for all of 2026-27 after Achilles surgery, forcing coach Rick Pitino to rework the Red Storm's rotation ahead of Big East play. Nationally, preseason camps are underway with the season set to open Nov. 2; Arkansas's Jordan Smith Jr. and Kansas's Tyran Stokes remain among the most-watched newcomers.
